headlines.text: Food and drink: 4,671 new companies in the last 6 months, up 4.8% on the 6 months before and +8.5% on the year.
Craft makers (bakers, roasters, brewers, distillers): 183 new companies in the last 6 months, up 18.1% on the 6 months before and +4.0% on the year.
Creative and culture (includes SIC 74, all other professional, scientific and technical services): 3,918 new companies in the last 6 months, down 5.2% on the 6 months before and +4.8% on the year.
Software and tech: 5,211 new companies in the last 6 months, up 14.9% on the 6 months before and +34.0% on the year.
NW5 is picking up fastest: 84 new companies in 6 months against 44 before.
DA6 is cooling fastest: 17 new companies in 6 months against 45 before.

Craft, creative, wellness and tech companies make up a higher share of new registrations than of existing ones in SW7, NW8, SM3: SW7's new companies are 70.6% in those sectors against 58.4% of what is there already.
New food and drink companies are registered most often in October (index 116, 100 = an average month) and least in December (89).
15.1% of food and drink companies formed 12 to 24 months ago are already being struck off or wound up, against 9.5% for creative and culture and 17.1% for retail.
Of 9,127 food and drink companies formed in the last year, 63.1% stand alone and 36.9% look linked to other food and drink companies (a shared name or address), a sign of groups and serial operators.
Matching 310 new premises to their companies: 53% belong to companies under a year old (new entrants) and 16% to companies over 3 years old (established operators adding a site or taking over).

method: Companies registered to a London postcode district in each sector, excluding mass-registration addresses. 'Linked' means a shared distinctive name stem or registered address with another food and drink company; the free file has no directors, so first-time founder is a likely, not a certain, label. Today's register is survivors, which slightly flatters the older half of any comparison. Premises are matched to companies by name within a postcode district, only when exactly one company fits.
